description: Sixty matched candidate/control groups for the adaptive intent-routing tunnel experiment.
question: Does adaptive routing reduce premature execution, over-planning, unsupported guessing, and runaway discovery while preserving approval and direction checkpoints?

arms.candidate: Reference adaptive policy: execute, explore_then_plan, or co_discover with a grounding floor and ceiling.
arms.control: Reference pre-adaptive binary policy: execute clear requests or produce a full Plan before acting.
